# § 831. Boundaries of the General Assembly Senate Districts.
The boundaries of the General Assembly Senate Districts shall be as set forth in the Final Senate Maps and the Census Block Breakdown by Senate District with the census tracts and census blocks descriptions published on the General Assembly's website, and include, by district, the following census tracts and blocks:
